review.notes: Blue-backdrop edges re-solved with tools/rematte_blue_plate.py (2026-10-11): purple fringes from the old blue-minus-max(red, green) matte removed; frames, timing, anchors and scale unchanged. Earlier review: Accepted after full original-frame chronological review, enlarged hand/pike/alpha inspection, all 281 new frames in native 128px overview and three Godot battle phases. Move has reciprocal boot contacts; attack preserves the rigid pike, regrips, contact and recovery; hit flinches and regrips without the rejected beam; defense holds a low brace; support raises and lowers the same pike without magic; death settles to a grounded side-lying corpse before the rejected later pose jump. Existing eight-frame articulated hand idle is preserved for battle and map. Original color-changing plates measured separately; support regenerated with a clean raised-pike guide. Review was frame-by-frame plus offscreen runtime phases, not continuous video playback or manual playtest. Candidate 935 focused Windows checks passed.
